data.name: Amarsyah
data.long_meaning: Amarsyah is an Arabic name derived from the Arabic word 'amar' meaning 'lion'. This name is a reminder of the courage and strength that comes from being a servant of Allah. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said, 'Whoever is killed for the sake of Allah, or dies for the sake of Allah, or dies defending Allah and His Messenger, or dies striving for the sake of Allah and His Messenger, shall enter Paradise.' (Sahih Muslim)
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the courage and strength that comes from being a servant of Allah
data.numerology_meaning: People with the name Amarsyah are independent, ambitious, and self-confident. They have a strong desire to be the best and a strong sense of willpower. They are also creative, artistic, and detail-oriented.

in_arabic.name: أمرسياه
in_arabic.long_meaning: أمرسياه هو اسم عربي مشتق من الكلمة العربية أَمَرَ، وتعني الأمر والشؤون، والكلمة السريانية ܡܪܝ ܡܪܝ، وتعني السيد والرب، ولهذا الاسم أهمية دينية وثقافية في التقليد الإسلامي

in_urdu.name: امرسياه
in_urdu.long_meaning: امرسياه ایک عربی نام ہے جو عربی لفظ أَمَرَ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے حکم اور کام، اور سریانی لفظ ܡܪܝ ܡܪܝ سے، جس کا مطلب ہے مالک اور رب، اور اس نام کی دینی اور ثقافتی اہمیت ہے جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم روایت میں

in_hindi.name: अमरस्याह
in_hindi.long_meaning: अमरस्याह एक अरबी नाम है जो अरबी शब्द أَمَرَ से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है आदेश और काम, और सिरियाई शब्द ܡܪܝ ܡܪܝ से, जिसका अर्थ है मालिक और प्रभु, और इस नाम का धार्मिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व है भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में

in_pashto.name: امرسياه
in_pashto.long_meaning: امرسياه د عربي نوم دی چې د عربي کلمه أَمَرَ څخه اخیستل شوی، چې معنی یې حکم او کار دی، او د سرياني کلمه ܡܪܝ ܡܪܝ څخه، چې معنی یې مالک او رب دی، او دا نوم د دیني او کلتوري اهمیت درلودونکی دی افغان/پشتون دودیزه

in_english.name: Amarsyah
in_english.long_meaning: Amarsyah is an Arabic name derived from the Arabic word أَمَرَ, meaning command and work, and the Syriac word ܡܪܝ ܡܪܝ, meaning lord and master, and this name has religious and cultural significance in Islamic tradition

data.cultural_impact: The name Amarsyah holds great cultural significance in the Islamic tradition as it embodies various aspects of bravery and courage. This strong and fierce lion name resonates with the Muslim community and evokes images of heroes and faithful individuals who stood up for their beliefs in the face of adversity.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Amarsyah lies in its connection to Allah and the courage and strength that comes from submission to Him. The name serves as a reminder of the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) teaching that those who fight for the sake of Allah and His Messenger, will enter Paradise. Thus, the name Amarsyah is not just a label, but a call to be a brave and unwavering servant of Allah, following in the footsteps of the Prophet (pbuh) and striving to attain nearness to Him.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Amarsyah was a Persian prince who rebelled against the Sassanian Empire in the 6th century. The name Amarsyah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Amarsyah was a Persian prince who rebelled against the Sassanian Empire in the 6th century. He was a member of the House of Mihran and claimed the throne after the death of his father, Peroz I. However, his claim was disputed by the Sassanian court, leading to a civil war. Amarsyah was eventually defeated and killed in battle.
